{{Short description|Ivorian academic and diplomat}}
[[File:SEM Denise HOUPHOUËT BOIGNY.jpg|thumb|Denise Houphouët-Boigny]]
'''Denise Houphouët-Boigny''' is an Ivorian academic and diplomat currently serving as Cote d'Ivoire's ambassador to [[UNESCO]]. She is a Doctor of Science and professor of mineral chemistry. She is a member of the Academy of Sciences, Arts, Cultures of Africa and African Diasporas of Côte d'Ivoire.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Son excellence Denise Houphouët-Boigny: de l’ombre à la lumière - Abidjan.net News|url=https://news.abidjan.net/articles/455070/son-excellence-denise-houphouet-boigny-de-lombre-a-la-lumiere|access-date=2021-09-23|website=news.abidjan.net|language=fr}}</ref>

== Education ==
Houphouët-Boigny earned DUES-PC2 in 1972 and a master’s degree in Chemistry in 1974 before obtaining a DES in physical sciences in 1976 and a doctorate in physical sciences in 1984.

== Career ==
She began her academic career at the National School of Public Works in Abidjan from 1975 to 1977 and later transferred to Laboratory of Inorganic Materials Chemistry of the UFR Satière Structural Sciences and Technologies as a teacher-researcher.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Redaction|title=Denise Houphouët-Boigny, à l’inauguration d’un groupe scolaire à Bingerville : "Le continent africain concentre encore les 2/3 des enfants déscolarisés dans le monde" {{!}} L'Intelligent d'Abidjan|url=https://www.lintelligentdabidjan.info/news/denise-houphouet-boigny-a-linauguration-dun-groupe-scolaire-a-bingerville-le-continent-africain-concentre-encore-les-23-des-enfants-descolarises-dans-le-monde/|access-date=2021-09-23|language=fr-FR}}</ref> She was an assistant professor at the [[Université Félix Houphouët-Boigny|University of Cocody]] in [[Ivory Coast|Côte d'Ivoire]] from 1985 to 1993 when she became a full professor. she was a member of the Scientific Council of the Faculty of Sciences and Techniques 1993 from 1996 before being appointed to the position of Director of Higher Education in the Ministry of higher education of Côte d'Ivoire from 1996 to 2006.<ref>{{Cite web|title=ASCAD : L’Académie des Sciences, des Arts, des Cultures d’Afrique et des Diasporas Africaines|url=http://www.ascad.ci/web/membreascad/professeur-houphout-boigny-denise542/2|access-date=2021-09-23|website=www.ascad.ci}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Académiciens|url=https://www.academieoutremer.fr/academiciens/|access-date=2021-09-23|website=Académie des sciences dʼoutre-mer|language=fr-FR}}</ref> She was appointed Permanent Delegate of the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire to UNESCO since 2011 and became a member of the Bureau of the General Conference of [[UNESCO]] since 2019.<ref>{{Cite news|date=1991-01-29|title=COTE-D'IVOIRE fidèle de M. Houphouët-Boigny Auguste Denise est décédé|language=fr|work=Le Monde.fr|url=https://www.lemonde.fr/archives/article/1991/01/29/cote-d-ivoire-fidele-de-m-houphouet-boigny-auguste-denise-est-decede_4014429_1819218.html|access-date=2021-09-23}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|title=Permanent Delegation of Ivory Coast to UNESCO|url=http://www.unesco.diplomatie.gouv.ci/mot-ambassadeur.php?lang=en&num=2}}</ref>

== Honors ==
* Officer in the National Order of Côte d'Ivoire,
* Commander in the Order of the National Education of Côte d'Ivoire,
* Knight in the Order of the French Legion of Honor.
